tooltip.yanyang_easement.easement_shape_: Use on a rail node to cycle the easement shape of its rails: classic, cubic parabola, half-wave sine. Sneak to cycle backwards. With ANTE installed you can also set the rail_shape key in its rail config editor.
message.yanyang_easement.no_rails: No rails connected to this node
message.yanyang_easement.no_permission: You don't have permission to modify rails
message.yanyang_easement.regen_hint: Rail appearance updates immediately; trains follow the new shape after their paths regenerate at the depot.
